inputData.transcriptSnippet: Welcome students. Today we examine semiconductor physics inside solar photovoltaic panels. When photons strike silicon, valence electrons absorb kinetic energy and flow across the p-n junction, generating direct electrical current.

outputData.title: Clean Energy & Solar Photovoltaic Systems
outputData.summary:
• Solar panels work using semiconductors like silicon.
• Light particles (photons) hit the silicon cell.
• This knocks electrons loose, creating an electric current.
• The resulting direct current (DC) is then converted for home use.

keyTerms.explanation: The process of turning light particles directly into electricity.
A tiny particle of light carrying radiant energy.
The boundary inside a semiconductor that guides electrical current in one direction.

quiz.question: What happens when light photons hit a solar cell?
options: Electrons absorb energy and flow to create electricity
The solar panel turns into a battery
quiz.correctAnswer: Electrons absorb energy and flow to create electricity
quiz.explanation: Photons transfer their energy to electrons, driving them across the junction as electric current.

inputData.textSnippet: Patient presents post-laparoscopic intervention. Continued ambulatory monitoring advised. Administer analgesics PRN, strictly refrain from lifting weight > 5kg, and ensure thromboprophylaxis stockings remain donned for 14 diurnal cycles.

outputData.plainLanguage: You had a minor keyhole surgery and are now recovering at home. Take your pain medicine only when you feel pain. Do not lift heavy objects over 10 pounds (like heavy grocery bags). Wear your tight compression socks for 2 weeks to stop blood clots from forming in your legs.
keyPoints: Take pain pills only when needed, not on an automatic timer.
Do not lift anything heavier than 5 kg (11 lbs) for the next 2 weeks.
Keep your medical socks on day and night for 14 days to keep blood flowing safely.
actionSteps: Set a daily reminder to check your wound for redness or swelling.
Schedule your follow-up clinic appointment within 14 days.
Call your doctor immediately if you develop sudden shortness of breath or calf pain.

glossary.definition: Keyhole surgery performed through very small cuts using a tiny camera.
A medical term meaning "take only when needed", not every hour.
Medical prevention steps taken to stop dangerous blood clots from forming.
